marquee:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a premium Chrome Web Store marquee image for the independent software LinkedIn MCP Bridge, which connects a LinkedIn browser session to a local AI/MCP client on macOS. Output a very wide horizontal 5:2 composition, ideally exactly 1400x560 pixels.
Art direction: exceptionally refined industrial product campaign, crisp sophisticated minimal 3D on a saturated deep ocean navy background #071e30 with subtle studio light. Three dimensional central bridge emblem: two upright pale ice-blue bars joined horizontally, like an H with a strong horizontal connecting bar, based on the software's existing bridge mark. The central emblem is small enough to leave breathing room, rendered as thick frosted ice-blue glass and satin aluminum, precise beveled edges, beautiful restrained highlights. To its left a rounded slate-blue tile bears a simple white profile silhouette and two short lines, to its right another matching tile bears a simple abstract four-point AI spark. The tiles and bridge linked by two gently sweeping glowing cyan cables, a coherent left-to-right connection. Sculptural solid objects with gentle grounded shadows, near frontal slightly elevated perspective, large negative space at top and sides, central arrangement occupies 65% of width and 65% of height. Purposefully composed at banner proportions, elegant and readable at small scale.
Absolutely no words, no letters beyond the abstract H-shaped bridge, no LinkedIn or third-party logos, no slogans, no fake UI, no watermarks, no decorative particle spray, no busy network mesh. Full bleed opaque background. This is the finished promotional art, not a page mockup or contact sheet.
small:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create the matching compact Chrome Web Store small promotional tile for LinkedIn MCP Bridge. Reference image: the previous wide promotional image is a style reference, preserve its exact family of materials and colors. Output one finished opaque full-bleed landscape image at 11:7 proportions, ideally 880x560 pixels (delivery target 440x280).
Recompose for this much more compact canvas. Deep ocean navy background, large beautiful central H-shaped connecting bridge made of two icy frosted blue glass upright bars and one horizontal satin-aluminum bar. A small rounded dark cobalt tile with a simple white profile pictogram on the left, a matching tile with a simple four-point AI sparkle on the right. Short luminous cyan connecting cables. Three sculptural objects form one close-knit centered group, fill 82% of width, with some breathing room. The bridge emblem should be visually dominant. Refined premium industrial advertising photography/render, grounded shadows, beautifully controlled restrained studio highlights. Readable even at 220x140 pixels.
No words, no slogans, no external brand logos, no watermark, no fake software interface, no border, no contact sheet.
